row.evidence: Nooks' SCIM guide says SCIM lets an IdP such as Okta or Azure AD automatically create, update and deactivate users in Nooks, while its pricing page only offers a custom quote from the sales team.
row.notes: Quote-only: Nooks publishes no plans or prices; the pricing page asks buyers to get a custom quote. SCIM 2.0 (https://api.nooks.in/scim/v2, bearer token generated by a workspace admin) works with Okta via the generic 'SCIM 2.0 Test App (OAuth Bearer Token)' and with an Entra enterprise app; the OIN 'Nooks' app is OIDC SSO only. Seats, add-ons (Coaching, International, Sequencing) and roles are driven by SCIM entitlements and roles arrays or group overrides. Setting active=false resets entitlements and frees seats. SCIM Team sync is feature-flagged and Okta-only. The public Sequencing API exposes read-only user endpoints.

plans.name: Custom quote
plans.price_text: Contact sales for a custom quote
plans.notes: No public tiers; seats (Bullpen, Power Dialer, Parallel Dialer) and add-ons are sold per contract.

auth.token_source: Settings → All Settings → User Management → Identity and Provisioning → SCIM Provisioning toggle → regenerate token

deprovision.notes: active=false resets all entitlements and frees assigned seats; deactivation revokes Nooks access and removes the user from mapped Teams.

roles.how: roles array (user, manager, admin) and entitlements array (seat + add-ons), per user or via admin group configuration overrides

limitations.text: SCIM Team sync (IdP group to Nooks Team) is behind a feature flag and currently supports Okta only.
Okta setup uses the generic SCIM 2.0 Test App, not the OIN Nooks app (which is OIDC SSO only).
Google/Microsoft sign-in cannot be disabled to force SSO-only login.

endpoints.purpose: List users with active seat assignments

rate_limits.text: List reads incl. /users: 300 requests/minute per endpoint per workspace; 429 with Retry-After when exceeded.

user_api.notes: The public Sequencing API only reads users; no create, update or deactivate user endpoints are documented outside SCIM. OAuth apps require a Sequencing or Coaching seat.

okta.notes: OIN 'Nooks' (last updated Sep. 20 2023) ticks OIDC only; SCIM uses Okta's generic SCIM 2.0 Test App per the vendor guide.

entra.notes: Vendor guides use a non-gallery Entra enterprise app for SAML and for SCIM provisioning.
